actions.action: Keep and grow two-region pea sourcing (Finland + Sweden) as a climate hedge
actions.evidence: FI pea: -7.7 % yield, EUR 169,052/yr risk (SSP2-4.5, 2041-2060). FI-SE yearly yield correlation r = -0.27: bad years rarely hit both regions.
actions.eur_label: pea climate risk to manage (FI + SE)
actions.next_week: Set a minimum Swedish share in the 2027 pea contract plan and agree a shortfall swap with Foodhills.
sources: climate.json risk (FI_SW pea, SE_SKANE pea, ssp245)

actions.action: Turnip rape: grower programme for heat and drought (earlier sowing, tolerant varieties)
actions.evidence: Largest yield loss: -11.3 % (SSP2-4.5), bad-year probability 15%. Expected shortfall 927 t/yr.
actions.eur_label: turnip rape replacement cost at risk
actions.next_week: Pick 20 pilot growers in the highest-risk grid cells and test earlier sowing in 2027.
